title: $1,000 in the S&P 500 in 1993 is now worth this
caption:
In 1993, the S&P 500 was the first US index ETF.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:SPY:1993-01-29} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with the S&P 500 in 1993? 👇
sources: the S&P 500 price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
